caveats: 101 bytes in PRG hold $58 (CLI); the induction covers reachable instruction starts only, so already-derailed control flow could clear I. That is a consequence of derailment, not a mechanism for causing it.
the NMI runs every frame regardless of the I flag; it is the interrupt that actually occurs, and it is in the reachable set.
masking.conclusion: a maskable IRQ can never be serviced: I is set by SEI at reset and no reachable CLI or PLP exists; RTI can only restore a status byte that already had I set
